title: Super Engineer: DeepSeek Harness 插件合集
description:
面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件合集：一个仓库收录多个可独立安装的插件，并附带收录校验（tools/verify.mjs）与打包工具（tools/pack.mjs）。每个插件遵循 DeepSeek Harness 的插件规范——不改动框架源码，只通过槽位系统与同源 Fetch 通道接入。

A collection of independently installable plugins for DeepSeek Harness, with manifest verification and packaging tooling. Plugins follow the harness plugin contract: no framework forking, only slots and a same-origin fetch channel.
notes: 本合集在开发过程中使用了 AI 助手（DeepSeek Harness 会话）参与代码与文档编写，署名见 creators。 / AI assistance (a DeepSeek Harness session) contributed code and documentation; credited above.
